F1: The optimized paginator applies `floor`/`ceil` to datetime values and does not convert cursor values back to datetimes.
F2: organization_context.member` is optional, so this unconditional access can raise `AttributeError`.
F3: Existing set-valued Redis keys are now accessed as sorted sets, causing `WRONGTYPE` errors while those buffers remain.
F4: Django querysets reject negative slice offsets, so the advanced branch can crash on a negative cursor offset.
